scenes.line1: What does a TLS cert really do?
scenes.say: Ever wonder what a TLS certificate actually does, and why engineers panic when one expires?

scenes.label: Cert
scenes.sub: Holds a public key and identity, signed by a trusted CA.
scenes.say: A TLS certificate holds a public key and proves who you are, thanks to a signature from a certificate authority.
The chain starts at your server's certificate, passes through an intermediate, and ends at a root trusted by browsers.

scenes.title: Check cert chain & expiry
scenes.say: You can check a site's certificate chain and expiration date using OpenSSL. This helps catch issues before they cause downtime.

scenes.question: What happens if a cert expires?
scenes.right: Browsers block access and users see scary warnings.
scenes.say: Here's a trap: if a certificate expires, browsers block users with big warnings. Outages are real and embarrassing.
